title: [Lean] Prove all-length cyclic Schur elimination and indexed passes (no new kappa)
body:
This formalizes the exact Euclidean chain/closure reduction used by Rohan Guliani (@Rohansguliani)'s [PR #846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/846) and Ali Romman (@aliromman)'s [PR #985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/985). For every `0 < w ≤ n`, Lean proves
the scalar system `y_i = x_i + b_i y_((i+n-w) mod n)` is equivalent to its
length-`w` closure plus reconstruction. The proof derives the endpoint
`n-w+k` and child stride `(-n) mod w`. It preserves coefficient order and
works over any semiring, without invertibility or norm assumptions.

Review files: [Proof and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/research/cyclic-schur-lean/CyclicSchur.lean) · [Evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/research/cyclic-schur-lean/AXIOMS.txt) · [Source pins and credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/research/cyclic-schur-lean/SOURCES.json).

An explicit sequential array evaluator models the two source passes.
Lean proves its prefix and suffix invariants, that Pass A emits the
closure data and products, and that Pass C reconstructs a parent solution
from a child solution. Restriction and reconstruction preserve existence
and distinguish every parent solution. This closes an exact indexed
elimination obligation; it does not assume that obligation as a leaf
contract.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
sh research/cyclic-schur-lean/verify.sh /path/to/lean-4.21.0/bin/lean
```

The package checks compiler commit
`6741444a63eec253a7eae7a83f1beb3de015023d`, uses core/Std only, and builds
in a fresh temporary directory. The final local command exited 0.
The axiom report covers all 102 theorem declarations, including generated
lemmas; all 30 named proof theorems and six reference/control theorems are
included. Only `propext`, `Quot.sound`, and `Classical.choice` occur.
Four mathematical controls reject wrong stride sign, wrong tail start,
an omitted coefficient, and a stale predecessor. Separate invalid-proof
probes are rejected specifically by the axiom guard.

Base: [8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20). Source subjects are
[PR #846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/846) [4bdb3e755ea7118170a7a34764df955880dec282](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/4bdb3e755ea7118170a7a34764df955880dec282) and [PR #985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/985)
[9df42a99dd8497b6e7d46cd2507bb89071372640](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/9df42a99dd8497b6e7d46cd2507bb89071372640); exact file pins and source
line links are included. Gareth Davidson (@bitplane)'s [PR #896](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/896)
[4e34d42b64ff05a4f293b9748d71642e14ef273d](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/4e34d42b64ff05a4f293b9748d71642e14ef273d) proves a separate generic
dirty commutator and is not imported. Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky)'s [PR #628](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/628) and Charles Bethin (@cbethin)'s [PR #764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/764) retain their predecessor credit.

Only [research/cyclic-schur-lean/](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/research/cyclic-schur-lean) is added. The Python solvers, precision
and phase contracts, selected frontier, and [upstream/](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/upstream) are unchanged.
Python/FIFO/tape semantics, fresh-power return times, rounding, dirty
restoration, physical costs, and the full multiplication theorem remain
separate. Global `make verify`, selected cold replay, and hosted CI were
not run. No new kappa, solver speedup, or new Schur algorithm is claimed.

Prepared for Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex
assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

Coordinator review: the full proof and package diff were read. A separate fresh build with the pinned compiler passed and reproduced [AXIOMS.txt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c4be063c0afb634db7aa02bc1876ff29640bec65/research/cyclic-schur-lean/AXIOMS.txt) byte for byte.

The [2026-10-14 follow-up review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c35966d2cbf0db075918c58b0ada4ee5a6dc7dcb/research/cyclic-schur-lean/FOLLOWUP-REVIEW.md) addresses the precise theorem and source-interface request. A fresh one-worker build with the pinned compiler passed and reproduced the complete axiom report byte for byte. All four source-file digests were checked; the later [PR #985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/985) change only reduces duplicate input-validation reads. The historical pins remain intact. The review separates the proved exact array model from the still-open Python, FIFO, fresh-power, rounding, restoration and tape obligations. No proof change or new kappa is claimed.
